scenarios.title: Redundant temporary variable in list emptiness check
scenarios.problem: Redundant temporary boolean `isEmpty` before return.

scenarios.notes: Replace ternary returning boolean literals with direct expression.

scenarios.title: Unnecessary intermediate string trim assignment
scenarios.problem: Unnecessary variable `trimmed` immediately returned without further processing.

scenarios.title: Duplicated local multiplication subexpression
scenarios.problem: Repeated expression `(a + b)` calculated twice instead of using local variable.

scenarios.title: Redundant null check before instanceof operator
scenarios.problem: `obj != null && obj instanceof String` has redundant null check because `instanceof` evaluates to false for null.
scenarios.evidence: return obj != null && obj instanceof String;
scenarios.notes: Simplify redundant null check before instanceof.

scenarios.title: Unnecessary boolean flag reassignment
scenarios.problem: Assigning `flag = true; return true;` makes the `flag` assignment redundant before immediate return.

scenarios.title: Unused char loop index variable
scenarios.problem: Local variable `iterationIndex` is incremented but never used in any calculation or returned.

scenarios.title: Off-by-one index boundary error in array loop
scenarios.problem: Loop condition `i <= array.length` causes `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` on last iteration.

scenarios.title: Inverted comparison operator in loyalty discount qualification
scenarios.problem: Inverted operator `points < 1000` incorrectly denies discount to loyal users having 1000 or more points.

scenarios.title: Wrong arithmetic operator in perimeter formula
scenarios.problem: Perimeter formula uses multiplication `2 * (w * h)` instead of addition `2 * (w + h)`.

scenarios.title: Inverted boolean return value in palindrome checker
scenarios.problem: Loop returns `true` upon finding mismatch and `false` after traversing entire string.

scenarios.title: Wrong constant offset in Celsius to Fahrenheit conversion
scenarios.problem: Temperature formula uses `+ 23.0` instead of standard `+ 32.0` offset.

scenarios.title: String reference comparison in command dispatch
scenarios.problem: Using `action == "START"` compares references instead of `equals()`.

scenarios.title: Incorrect substring end index bound in prefix extractor
scenarios.problem: Substring end index uses `length` instead of `maxLength` when string is longer than maxLength.

scenarios.title: Integer division in aspect ratio calculation
scenarios.problem: Integer division `width / height` truncates to integer before cast/assignment.
scenarios.notes: Cast operand to double to prevent integer truncation.

scenarios.title: Wrong conjunction in input validation
scenarios.problem: `val < min && val > max` is an impossible condition; should use `||`.

scenarios.title: Swapped operands in balance deduction
scenarios.problem: Subtraction operands `amount - currentBalance` are inverted for balance deduction.

scenarios.title: Wrong Math clamp function in rate cap
scenarios.problem: Using `Math.max(floor, val)` with ceiling check inverted.

scenarios.title: Wrong counter operator in countdown loop
scenarios.problem: Loop decrements with `remaining++` instead of `remaining--`, causing infinite loop.

scenarios.title: Swapped longitude and latitude assignment
scenarios.problem: Fields latitude and longitude are assigned in reverse.

scenarios.title: Wrong fallback status returned on unknown input
scenarios.problem: Unknown log levels return `LogLevel.ERROR` instead of `LogLevel.INFO` default.

scenarios.title: Buffer slice index offset calculation error
scenarios.problem: Slice calculations add offset twice to destination array copy.

scenarios.title: Inverted string emptiness condition in validator
scenarios.problem: Inverted condition returns true when string is empty.
scenarios.notes: Fix inverted boolean return on empty string.

scenarios.title: Operator precedence in linear interpolation calculation
scenarios.problem: Missing parentheses in lerp formula `start + end - start * t` calculates `(end - (start * t))`.
scenarios.notes: Add necessary parentheses to enforce arithmetic precedence.

scenarios.title: Incorrect retry attempts decrement and status return
scenarios.problem: Attempts are reset to 0 instead of decremented upon failure in retry cycle.
scenarios.notes: Fix state mutation in retry policy.

scenarios.title: Wrong status code constant for HTTP Created
scenarios.problem: HTTP Created uses 200 instead of standard 201 code.

scenarios.title: Hardcoded JWT HMAC signing secret key
scenarios.problem: Hardcoded symmetric secret key in version control poses severe authentication bypass risk.
scenarios.notes: Security findings must be skipped by Fix Agent.

scenarios.title: SQL injection vulnerability via direct string concatenation
scenarios.problem: Dynamic SQL query built via string concatenation allows SQL injection attacks.
scenarios.evidence: String sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'";
scenarios.notes: Security injection issues must be safely skipped.

scenarios.title: Path traversal vulnerability via unsanitized file path
scenarios.problem: Directly reading file using client-supplied path parameter allows directory traversal attacks (`../`).

scenarios.title: Unclosed Socket resource leak without try-with-resources
scenarios.problem: Socket connection is created without try-with-resources or close() in finally block, causing resource leak.
scenarios.notes: Absence of resource cleanup requires block wrapping and architectural restructuring.

scenarios.title: Missing null check guard before nested method invocation
scenarios.problem: Missing null guard on customer reference before accessing customer address.
scenarios.notes: Absence of defensive null guards is safely skipped.

scenarios.title: Missing synchronization on compound shared counter increment
scenarios.problem: Missing concurrency synchronization on shared field `counter++` causes data race across worker threads.
scenarios.notes: Absence of concurrency constructs is safely skipped.

scenarios.title: Missing catch block for NumberFormatException in integer parser
scenarios.problem: Missing try-catch guard around `Integer.parseInt` to handle malformed non-numeric input gracefully.
scenarios.notes: Absence of try-catch block is skipped.
